card.name: Pest control and safety-to-health wording
card.fires_on: Scattered words in pesticide, cleaning-product and environmental-protection passages, such as "human" in "safeguard human health" or "your" before "family's health". The pole fires on the word just before a health, safety or damage term.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about earthquakes, destruction and vandalism and away from medical or body terms.
card.plain: It marks spots in pest-control and cleaning text where the next word may be about harm or damage, not about the body or medicine.
